findings.rule: Title-block heat treatment and heat-treatment notes must agree and fully define the requirement.
findings.reasoning: The title block lists heat treatment as "---", while note N5 requires the part to be through hardened up to 55 HRC. This is an inconsistent and incomplete heat-treatment specification.
findings.correction: Update the title-block heat-treatment field to reflect the required heat treatment and provide a complete hardness specification, including minimum/maximum HRC or an applicable standard/area.

findings.rule: A functional bore/hole must have a complete diameter dimension with tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: F2 is identified as the inner cylindrical bore, but its associated dimensions include only D2 "+0.2", which is a tolerance without a nominal diameter, and D3, a linear 22 mm dimension. No nominal bore diameter or fit is defined, so the bore cannot be manufactured or inspected to intent.
findings.correction: Add the missing bore diameter dimension with an appropriate tolerance or fit class, for example ⌀XX H7, and associate it with F2. Clarify or reassign D2 if it is not the bore diameter tolerance.
